CaptureLoss.description: Independent capture losses and unavailable owner facts.

output_exhausted.description: The retained output allowance ended collection.

queued_packets_dropped.description: Lifecycle packets refused by the bounded optional caller-composed layer.

refused_items.description: Exporter identity/event state refused by its working allowance.

sampling_inherited_tasks.description: CPU sampling inherits newly created threads and forked tasks, beyond published thread IDs.

sampling_loss_unknown.description: CPU kernel loss was not quantified by this adapter; never silently reported as zero.

sampling_overlap_possible.description: Independently attached related processes may duplicate inherited samples; never sum them.

source_partial.description: At least one owner checkpoint reported observation or thread loss.

unknown_clock.description: Some actual-time facts could not align to the same-host clock and were omitted.

CaptureOutput.description: A retained file and the readable complete prefix observed by its owner.

bytes.description: Bytes last observed, possibly including an incomplete tail.

path.description: File owned by the capture, retained after session stop/drop.

readable.description: The published prefix can be decoded in this format.

readable_prefix_bytes.description: Flushed complete packet offset, or whole file length after successful tool completion.

CaptureSymbols.description: Symbol evidence from a completed bounded perf-script decode, never just file creation.

checked.description: Decoder successfully completed; false also covers not selected/not yet attempted.

names.description: Small recognizable name prefix, not proof of every frame or correct unwinding.

resolved_frames.description: Actual decoded frames with names other than unknown/address placeholders.

unresolved_frames.description: Actual decoded frames without useful names.

CaptureTarget.description: One actual process followed by capture; process CPU is never operation-exclusive CPU.

clock_uncertainty_nanoseconds.description: Reported clock mapping uncertainty; missing is unavailable, never exact zero.

concurrent_operations.description: Target also had operations outside the selected graph; samples are inclusive.

locator.description: OS attachment identity copied from its owner.

process.description: Diagnostic process instance, scoped independently from OS PID reuse.

thread_ids.description: Last published actual native thread IDs for the selected operation set.

threads_partial.description: Thread publication was bounded or unavailable.

OperationIdBody.description: Process instance plus local sequence; never a semantic or cache identity.

process_instance.description: Process-local instance locator; not a semantic identity or attestation.

ProcessLocatorBody.description: Actual process locator. PID reuse must be checked before attaching an optional sampler.

executable.description: Current executable path for display/symbol discovery, not a content proof.

start_ticks.description: Linux process start ticks; absence does not authorize attachment.

description: Typed capture answer; it contains no scientific results or result permissions.

errors.description: Bounded independent diagnostic failures; none changes a target outcome.

launch_process.description: Exact launched command process; absent for checkpoint-based attachment.

observed_duration.description: Actual elapsed collection interval from exporter start (no retrospective CPU samples).

open_intervals.description: Intervals actually begun without an observed actual end, including interrupted ones.

operation.description: Selected root diagnostic operation, absent for a process launch without one.

outputs.description: Retained raw and projected files, including readable prefix boundaries.

related_operations.description: Actual published operation relationships; an empty list means not observed.

symbols.description: CPU symbol evidence; timeline collection leaves this unchecked.

targets.description: Known process and actual native-thread attribution; CPU includes inherited tasks.

title: CaptureDocument
